article_limitations: Caption-layer visual status not_inspected; the three figure images are reviewed in the separate visual submission.
Cohort-level counts and percentages in the abstract, Results text and Table 1 are not copied to individual patients; text sentences that name no case are not assigned to a patient.

The text says eight patients received dietitian input and a low-fat diet, while Table 2 lists fasting then a low-fat diet for nine cases; both are kept without reconciliation because the cohort sentence does not name the cases.
The text says two patients had previous HTGAP admissions before July 2017 while Table 2 marks three cases Previous AP Y; Previous AP is recorded only as the table prints it.
Table 2 prints Previous resection in the Gallstones on Imaging cell for Cases 2 and 4 without naming the organ; recorded as a historical procedure with no site.

Table 2 prints glued management entries; each listed entry is recorded as an in-patient management item without a time unless the entry prints one. Lipid-lowering drugs listed there may be continued home therapy or newly started; the action is recorded as administered.
Values printed inside images (Figure 1 flow chart counts, Figure 2 axes) are pixel content kept in the visual submission only.

Table 2 footnote defines Y = Yes, N = No and NA = Not available; N cells are recorded as explicit negatives (assertion absent) and NA cells for BMI, HbA1c and the 24 h triglyceride as not available. APACHE II NA cells for non-ICU cases are not recorded (APACHE II was calculated only for ICU admissions).
Case 10 intravenous insulin rate is a source conflict (Table 2: 4 to 6 units/h, 0.06 units/kg/h; Figure 2 caption: 8 units/h, 0.1 units/kg/h); both rate statements are review-only.
Case 6: Table 2 says the infusion was increased after 5 h while the text links the increase to the peak seven hours after presentation; kept as an ambiguity because the table entry names no anchor.

The text-level counts (eight patients with dietitian input; two patients with previous HTGAP admissions) name no cases and are not patient-level conflicts with Table 2 (nine low-fat diet entries; three Previous AP Y cells).
Charlson Comorbidity Index values are recorded as observations (comorbidity index), APACHE II values as symptoms_function scores.
Figure 2 panel titles Case 1, Case 6, Case 9 and Case 10 are printed on the image and are used as panel labels; the FIG-LABELS gate warning is a false positive here.

No measurement series sidecar: Table 2 is one row per patient (admission and 24 h triglyceride columns), and the serial triglyceride and insulin values exist only as unlabelled plot points in Figure 2.
